entry.title: Audio to score and a test of symbolic control
entry.summary: Promote direct audio-to-score research into the core reading path, correct its treatment in the report, and evaluate explicit melody control with YuE2 after unsuccessful ACE-Step listening tests.

entry.title: Music to score, score to music: the anatomy of a song generator
entry.summary: Three Suno uploads of one piano recording came back as audio and nothing readable. A technical report dissects why — codec-token language models through four lenses — and specifies the inverse: a notation-native latent that transcribes in and renders out, with latent actions as the edit primitive.

entry.title: From data to a labelled dataset: the David Foster corpus
entry.summary: The ACE experiment gets its corpus: 28 David Foster songs from two albums and a YouTube compilation, cut as whole songs, with captions drafted from the audio and confirmed by ear in a private web workbench.

entry.title: ACE moves from idea to runnable experiment
entry.summary: An ACE-Step 1.5 fine-tuning pipeline now passes a synthetic end-to-end CPU smoke. Real ACE weights, the RTX PRO 5000 run, and original piano data are next.

entry.title: From a research agenda to a product musicians can use
entry.summary: Music Kitchen takes shape as a personal arranging studio. The key question becomes how a musician directs the second and third revision through sound, examples, and gestures.
